facts.text: The image is a composite character reference sheet with a large nighttime hero image at top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and four detail panels along the bottom.

In the top hero image, a character stands upright on a wet elevated urban walkway or rooftop with metal railings on both sides, looking off to the left amid visible rain streaks and blurred city lights.
The hero character wears a black collared jacket, a dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The label "HERO" is centered beneath the top image.
The middle row contains three full-body views labeled "FRONT", "SIDE PROFILE", and "BACK" against a dark charcoal studio-like background.
In the FRONT panel, the character faces the camera with arms at the sides; in the SIDE PROFILE panel, the character faces left; in the BACK panel, the character faces away from the camera.
The character has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot or bun at the back of the head.
The bottom row has four detail panels labeled "FACE", "JACKET COLLAR", "HANDS", and "BOOTS".
The FACE panel is a close-up showing the character's undercut hairstyle, facial skin texture, and a neutral, serious expression.
The JACKET COLLAR panel shows a close view of dark jacket fabric with straps and dark hardware near the collar.
The HANDS panel shows two weathered hands with visible skin texture, one hand angled with fingers loosely curled.
The BOOTS panel shows a pair of black lace-up combat boots with worn, textured leather.
The overall palette is dominated by black, charcoal, and cool blue-gray tones, with warm amber highlights from distant city lights.
